title: Vietnam Full Country Fortnight
alt: Red sand dunes at Mui Ne on the south central coast
transport: Flights, private transfers and guided day tours

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: A first night in the old quarter with the evening free around Hoan Kiem lake.

stops.name: Sa Pa
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel in the middle of Sa Pa town, near the lake

activities.name: Cat Cat village walk
activities.description: A half day on foot down into Cat Cat, a Black Hmong village of terraced fields, water wheels and a waterfall below Sa Pa.

program.name: Sa Pa
program.description: North into the hills for a night, with an afternoon walk down to Cat Cat village.

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.subtitle: Fansipan, Hanoi and Ninh Binh
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small boutique hotel in the old quarter

activities.name: Fansipan mountain tour
activities.description: The cable car up Fansipan, the highest peak in Indochina, to the shrines and the viewing platform at the summit.

activities.name: Ninh Binh day tour
activities.description: South to Ninh Binh for a rowing boat through the flooded caves at Tam Coc and the limestone country around it.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: The Fansipan summit on the way down from the hills, then a full day south in Ninh Binh.

stops.name: Halong Bay

activities.name: Halong Bay overnight cruise
activities.description: A shared cruise out among the limestone islands, with lunch and dinner on board and a night moored in a quiet bay.

program.name: Halong Bay

stops.name: Da Nang
stops.subtitle: Da Nang and Ba Na Hills

activities.name: Surprise Cave on Bo Hon island
activities.description: A morning climb into the Surprise Cave, three great chambers of stalactites above the water, before the flight south.

activities.name: Ba Na Hills with the Golden Bridge

activities.description: The long cable car up to Ba Na, the bridge held up by two stone hands, and the French village and gardens at the top.

program.name: Da Nang

stops.name: Phu Quoc

activities.name: Phu Quoc south island tour with snorkelling
activities.description: A boat down to the An Thoi islets for snorkelling over the reef, with the pepper farms and fish sauce distilleries on the way back.

program.name: Phu Quoc
program.description: Two nights at a beach resort on the island, with a boat day down to the southern islets.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.subtitle: Saigon, the Mekong and Mui Ne

activities.name: Mekong Delta day tour
activities.description: South to My Tho for a boat into the coconut creeks, a sampan through the palms, and the workshops where they make coconut candy.

activities.name: Mui Ne sand dunes tour
activities.description: The red and white dunes above the fishing village at Mui Ne, with a jeep across the sand and the Fairy Stream below.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: Four nights in District 1 to finish, with the Mekong Delta, the Mui Ne dunes and free days.

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Two weeks and almost nothing left out: the hills, the bay, the centre, an island and the dunes.
expert.tip: Mui Ne is an early start from Saigon. Go for the white dunes first, before the wind picks the sand up.

summary: A fortnight the length of the country: Sa Pa and the Fansipan summit, Ninh Binh, an overnight cruise in Halong Bay, Ba Na Hills from Da Nang, two nights at a beach resort on Phu Quoc with a snorkelling boat day, then four in Saigon with the Mekong Delta and the Mui Ne dunes.
included: Included: 13 nights with breakfast and dinner daily and all meals on the cruise boat; all domestic flights; private transfers throughout; a Cat Cat village walk; the Fansipan mountain tour; a Ninh Binh day tour; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave; a full day at Ba Na Hills with the Golden Bridge; a Phu Quoc south island tour with snorkelling; a Mekong Delta day tour; a Mui Ne sand dunes tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches other than on the cruise; travel insurance; personal expenses.
